title: Agent P Private Engine Runtime
user_summary: Implement private engine loader, signature verify, provider gateway adapter, and fake private engine runtime foundation.
technical_summary: Agent P implements Manifest Loader, signature verification interface, Provider Gateway adapter, Engine Runtime Adapter, and Fake Private Engine. Must not implement formal analysis algorithms or formal prompts.
acceptance_criteria: Loader verifies signature/protocol/app version before load
Provider Gateway used for all inference; credentials never in DTOs
Fake Private Engine for tests only; no real binary load in this phase
No formal prompts or real model calls

data_compatibility.notes: Runtime adapters only; no new tables.
